quarters.revenue_scope: U.S. Qutenza net product revenue: NeurogesX's 'Net product revenue' line through 2012Q3 and, from 2013Q3, Acorda Therapeutics' 'net revenue from the sale of Qutenza' to its specialty distributors. Acorda's rights cover the U.S., Canada and Latin America, but its 10-Q notes state that Qutenza is distributed in the United States by two specialty distributors and that net product revenues reported to date are derived from sales of Ampyra, Zanaflex and Qutenza in the United States (Q1 2014 10-Q, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1008848/000100884814000030/quarterly_report-033114.htm; Q3 2015 10-Q, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1008848/000100884815000054/report_quarterly-093015.htm).
